folds.heading: ## Feasibility-use reconciliation B136, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full633-line E1–E41/matrix/families1a–1g and2–22/F1–F8/rank1–14/P1–P10/Q1–Q6 read. Preserve many genuinely different mechanisms, input owners and narrow suggested slices, without accepting their effort estimates, example numbers, risk labels or old build order. Source snippets cited here were not all reread by this reconciliation. Current card/state/module/action/heir and keyed-stream/peek/call source inspected in B132/B135 qualify the old absent-owner/unwired/native-unseeded claims at exact named seams. The proposed expansion.cheats/cards schema differs from actual native-envelope cheats/held/known; do not add a parallel owner or new capability kind merely because the palette names a cheat. Arbitrary data hooks are not runnable handlers. Current AD51 permits reasonable shared design while actual selected consumers validate it.

Differentiate passive known-record reading from actual appraisal, new forecast, manipulation, acquisition, payment and disclosure. A new noisy observation must commit its real result/cost/receipt; calling appraisal a pure read does not implement that transaction. False/dated claims remain attributed and cannot expose hidden change by automatic stale markers. A prophecy is not broken by every unrelated player commit, nor must it be wrong because of its grade. Exact means and free/clean variants remain possible. Four outcomes in ten synthetic dreams is a sample frequency, not calibrated world probability. Actual companion knowledge can differ from the player’s and travels through communication; the default is not omniscience or forced player-only mind limits.

Source/technique copying, teaching, body carriage, partner agency, law authority, material stock and per-world currency remain distinct. An inherited method needs actual means, not the donor’s body from a label. An already discovered truth genuinely carried by a supported memory route need not be automatically resealed until a forced repeat discovery; actual carrier/observer/discovery rules govern. Opaque ID/clue filters protect unrevealed truth, not a blanket ban on capable sight.

Loop conservation, rolls and source retention are authored mechanisms: a world can support restored inputs with retained gains or genuine rerolls as its powerful premise. Distinguish that from unintended double settlement, mixing incompatible snapshots or failed-write duplication. No universal compensating cost, quest penalty/debt, spirit feeding need, affection gate, shelf cap, hourly clock or sign-in streak rule follows from these examples. Negative capability grants are not required; actual conditions/cost owners can implement selected burdens. Banked away time does not imply free closed-browser world advancement, and local anchors are not whole-life snapshots.

Single envelope publication or a valid JSON owner does not establish every native loader, old-reader behavior, closure/cancel policy or cross-owner rollback. Existing input/definition/stream/quote identities, known disclosure and retained cause/result authority need actual selected proof. B134’s detached-fork/no-real-world-effect and non-mandatory-divergence qualifications apply. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), AD32/AD38/AD42/AD51/AD52 in [rules index](../../../RULES_INDEX.md) govern retired first milestone, optional review, mechanism scope and activity abstraction. Q4’s one-prestige gate is retired; old Village sign-in-first and ten-slice sequence do not launch work or require new approval. No source, native UI, private save, benchmark or prototype was changed/run.

folds.heading: ## Reader C uptake B136, 2026-11-04
folds.body: The full [633-line feasibility reader](readers/C_feasibility.md#feasibility-use-reconciliation-b136-2026-11-04) is independently reviewed. Together with B133–B135, all four underlying reader texts now have actual-content dispositions, not transitive synthesis credit. Preserve each original source/test/scratch scope. The old first-slice order and one-prestige question are historical; actual card owner shapes/current streams and consumer proof govern a selected operation. Appraisal/disclosure/payment are real acts, old known-record browsing is a projection, and source/body/technique/stock/currency do not merge merely because one card promises them. Native delivery remains separate; no family implementation or suite was rerun.

folds.heading: ## Family-feasibility reconciliation B136, 2026-11-04
folds.body: The complete [feasibility catalogue](audits/cheat-implementation-2026-10-10/readers/C_feasibility.md#feasibility-use-reconciliation-b136-2026-11-04) preserves families1–22 and simulator modes as proposed variants, without a mandatory fourteen-rank build order. Reuse actual card/command/resource/claim/knowledge/stream owners; its illustrative expansion.cheats/cards schema is not the current native owner. Distinguish known-record browsing, actual new observation, paid forecast, override and source acquisition. Exact/free means, no-penalty quests and lawful powerful loop variants remain possible. Carried learned knowledge is not forcibly forgotten, companions have their own actual knowledge, and unknown private changes do not create visible stale clues. Snapshot/cost/cause identity and actual consumer/native evidence remain necessary for selected delivery. Current AD42/AD51/AD52 and retired milestone govern; no family or whole-library completion is claimed.
